name: qui
short_desc: Fast, modern web UI for qBittorrent with multi-instance support, cross-seed, and automations.
description: A fast, modern web interface for qBittorrent. Manage multiple qBittorrent instances from a single lightweight application. Features cross-seed automation to find and add matching torrents across trackers, rule-based torrent management with conditions and actions, scheduled backups with multiple restore modes, a transparent qBittorrent reverse proxy for external apps, and multi-language support with automatic browser-language detection.
author: autobrr
